description: This Java class, HelloController, is a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that provides basic health, documentation redirect, and application info endpoints.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing health, documentation, and info endpoints

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the server is running

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a plain text 'OK' indicating application health status
